name: Three-Cube PC-Minor Basis for Two-Dimensional Partial Cubes
statement: A finite partial cube has VC dimension at most two if and only if it has no pc-minor isomorphic to $Q_3$. The obstruction $Q_3$ is pc-minimal outside the class.
proof: A shattered triple projects to the full cube $Q_3$, and a $Q_3$ pc-minor shatters three coordinates. A proper pc-minor of $Q_3$ cannot shatter all three coordinates: a proper restriction omits a required cube vertex, while a proper contraction deletes a coordinate. Hence every proper pc-minor has VC dimension at most two.
